name: 58601 · Dickinson, ND
findings: ZIP 58601 (Dickinson) has 99 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 58601 (Dickinson) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
